Sources.Name: Windows Desktop Optimization Tool (The Virtual Desktop Team)
Sources.Note: Names of services, tasks, AppX packages, autologgers and registry values are taken as facts; selection, explanations and risk notes are our own. No code and no runtime dependency.

Sources.Name: Microsoft Learn: Configure Microsoft Defender Antivirus on a remote desktop or virtual desktop infrastructure environment
Sources.Note: Page date 2026-08-20. Settings only; no text copied.

Sources.Name: AVDTune
Sources.Note: Own entries, each with its own Microsoft source.

Entries.Title: Windows Search: no web results
Entries.Why: Start and taskbar search send queries to Bing and show web results. On a multi-session host that is traffic and clutter for every user; local search stays.
Entries.Name: ConnectedSearchUseWeb

Entries.Title: Windows Search: no cloud search
Entries.Why: Stops Windows Search from querying cloud content (Microsoft account, Microsoft 365) from the search box. Local and Outlook search are not affected.
Entries.Name: AllowCloudSearch

Entries.Title: Windows Search: no search highlights
Entries.Why: Turns off the daily picture and highlights in the search box. They load content from the internet at every sign-in.
Entries.Name: EnableDynamicContentInWSB

Entries.Title: Windows Search: no location for search
Entries.Why: Search does not use the location of the computer. A session host has no meaningful location.
Entries.Name: AllowSearchToUseLocation

Entries.Title: Windows Search: no Cortana above the lock screen
Entries.Why: Removes the voice assistant entry from the lock screen. Cortana is gone from current Windows 11 builds; the policy only keeps old images clean.
Entries.Name: AllowCortanaAboveLock

Entries.Title: Windows Search: do not index uncached Exchange folders
Entries.Why: Keeps the search index from pulling mail that is not in the Outlook cache. On a shared host this avoids heavy index load and traffic per user.
Entries.Name: PreventIndexingUncachedExchangeFolders

Entries.Title: Widgets and news feed off
Entries.Why: The Widgets board loads news and weather per user and runs its own web view process in every session. Off saves memory and logon time.
Entries.Name: AllowNewsAndInterests

Entries.Title: Taskbar news and interests (feeds) off
Entries.Why: Old Windows 10 style news feed on the taskbar. Same reason as the Widgets board.
Entries.Name: EnableFeeds

Entries.Title: No consumer features (suggested apps, promoted tiles)
Entries.Why: Stops Windows from installing suggested and promoted apps at first sign-in of every user. Each install costs logon time and disk in the profile.
Entries.Name: DisableWindowsConsumerFeatures

Entries.Title: No welcome tips and tricks (soft landing)
Entries.Why: Switches off the tips that appear after the first sign-in and after updates.
Entries.Name: DisableSoftLanding

Entries.Title: Windows Copilot off
Entries.Why: Turns the Copilot entry off. Newer builds replace this policy with an app policy, so it may do nothing there; harmless on a build that ignores it.
Entries.Name: TurnOffWindowsCopilot

Entries.Title: No first sign-in animation
Entries.Why: The animation and the "Hi" welcome screens delay the first sign-in of every new profile on a pooled host.
Entries.Name: EnableFirstLogonAnimation

Entries.Title: No acrylic blur on the sign-in screen
Entries.Why: Blur effects on the sign-in screen cost GPU or CPU time in a remote session.
Entries.Name: DisableAcrylicBackgroundOnLogon

Entries.Title: No app notifications on the lock screen
Entries.Why: App notifications on the lock screen are of no use in a remote session and can show content of another app to a person standing at the client.
Entries.Name: DisableLockScreenAppNotifications

Entries.Title: Do not list connected users at sign-in
Entries.Why: On a multi-session host the sign-in screen would list the other users that are connected. Off hides their names from each other.
Entries.Name: DontEnumerateConnectedUsers

Entries.Title: Customer Experience Improvement Program off
Entries.Why: Stops usage data collection for the program that no one on a managed image decides about.
Entries.Name: CEIPEnable

Entries.Title: Application compatibility inventory off
Entries.Why: The inventory collector scans installed programs and sends data to Microsoft. It costs I/O at every boot of a pooled host.
Entries.Name: DisableInventory

Entries.Title: No feedback notifications
Entries.Why: Users of a company image get no feedback prompts from Windows.
Entries.Name: DoNotShowFeedbackNotifications

Entries.Title: Advertising ID off by policy
Entries.Why: Apps cannot use a per-user advertising ID. Privacy default for managed images.
Entries.Name: DisabledByGroupPolicy

Entries.Title: Game recording and broadcasting off
Entries.Why: GameDVR starts a capture service per session. It has no use on an AVD session host.
Entries.Name: AllowGameDVR

Entries.Title: Delivery Optimization: no peering (simple mode)
Entries.Why: Download mode 99 keeps Windows from sharing updates with other devices. On a pool of identical VMs peering gives nothing and adds traffic.
Entries.Name: DODownloadMode

Entries.Title: BITS: BranchCache off
Entries.Why: BranchCache peer caching is not used on a session host in a data centre network.
Entries.Name: DisableBranchCache

Entries.Title: Location services and sensors off
Entries.Why: Switches the location platform off for every user. Apps that need a location (Maps, weather, some Teams features) lose it; a session host has no real position anyway.
Entries.Name: DisableLocation

Entries.Title: Windows Ink Workspace off
Entries.Why: The ink workspace is not available in a remote session without a pen device; off removes its taskbar entry.
Entries.Name: AllowWindowsInkWorkspace

Entries.Title: System Restore off
Entries.Why: Restore points are useless on a pooled host that is reset on every start and would fill the disk of a persistent one. Persistent personal hosts may want them.
Entries.Name: DisableSR

Entries.Title: No disk health model downloads
Entries.Why: Stops the download of disk failure prediction data. Virtual disks have no such data.
Entries.Name: AllowDiskHealthModelUpdates

Entries.Title: Find My Device off
Entries.Why: Device location for a lost laptop does not apply to a virtual machine.
Entries.Name: AllowFindMyDevice

Entries.Title: No automatic map downloads
Entries.Why: The Maps app does not download map data in the background.
Entries.Name: AutoDownloadAndUpdateMapData

Entries.Title: Text message sync off
Entries.Why: Cloud sync of text messages does not apply to a session host.
Entries.Name: AllowMessageSync

Entries.Title: No speech model updates
Entries.Why: Stops the background download of speech models.
Entries.Name: AllowSpeechModelUpdate

Entries.Title: AutoRun off
Entries.Why: Disables AutoRun for all drive types. Redirected drives of the client should never start something on the host.
Entries.Name: NoAutoRun

Entries.Title: AutoRun: all drive types
Entries.Why: Complements AutoRun off: value 255 covers every drive type.
Entries.Name: NoDriveTypeAutoRun

Entries.Title: No Windows Insider preview builds
Entries.Why: Keeps preview builds from being offered on the image.
Entries.Name: AllowBuildPreview

Entries.Title: Connected Devices Platform off
Entries.Why: Cross-device experiences are of no use on a session host. WDOT and VDOT notes say that disabling CDPSvc-related features is linked to crashes of the Settings app, so this stays off by default.
Entries.Name: EnableCdp

Entries.Title: No device metadata from the network
Entries.Why: Windows does not download device pictures and metadata for redirected devices.
Entries.Name: PreventDeviceMetadataFromNetwork

Entries.Title: Do not search Windows Update for drivers
Entries.Why: Image builds stay deterministic. Can block driver installs on a host that needs a vendor driver from Windows Update.
Entries.Name: DontSearchWindowsUpdate

Entries.Title: File History off
Entries.Why: File History does not work with profile containers and would write copies into them.
Entries.Name: Disabled

Entries.Title: Cloud push notifications off
Entries.Why: Stops cloud notifications to the host. Toast notifications of Teams and Outlook are separate apps and are not affected, but check on a pilot host.
Entries.Name: NoCloudApplicationNotification

Entries.Title: Delete firewall app container rules at sign-out
Entries.Why: Removes the per-user app container firewall entries when a user signs out, so they do not pile up on a shared host.
Entries.Name: DeleteUserAppContainersOnLogoff

Entries.Title: Window animations off
Entries.Why: Disables window animation in the desktop window manager for all users. Saves display bandwidth; users see windows appear without fading.
Entries.Name: DisallowAnimations

Entries.Title: Time zone redirection on
Entries.Why: Sessions take the time zone of the client. Without it every user sees the time zone of the host (often UTC).
Entries.Name: fEnableTimeZoneRedirection

Entries.Title: Storage Sense off
Entries.Why: Storage Sense cleans per user at times the user does not choose. On a pooled host the profile is a container that is thrown away anyway.
Entries.Name: AllowStorageSenseGlobal

Entries.Title: Edge: startup boost off
Entries.Why: Startup boost keeps Edge processes alive in every session after sign-in. On a shared host that costs memory for users who never open Edge.
Entries.Name: StartupBoostEnabled

Entries.Title: Edge: no background mode
Entries.Why: Edge keeps running after the last window is closed. Off lets the process end with the window.
Entries.Name: BackgroundModeEnabled

Entries.Title: Edge: sleeping tabs on
Entries.Why: Inactive tabs sleep and free memory. Direct memory saving on a host with many sessions.
Entries.Name: SleepingTabsEnabled

Entries.Title: Edge: hardware acceleration off (VMs without GPU)
Entries.Why: Without a GPU the software path is faster and steadier. Leave this unchecked on hosts with a GPU. An older Golden Master log set the value to 1 (on) while its text said off: this entry sets the value 0 and shows the current value.
Entries.Name: HardwareAccelerationModeEnabled

Entries.Title: Chrome: efficiency mode on
Entries.Why: Chrome frees memory of inactive tabs. Only has an effect when Chrome is installed.
Entries.Name: HighEfficiencyModeEnabled

Entries.Title: Chrome: no background mode
Entries.Why: Chrome keeps running after the last window is closed. Off lets the process end with the window. Only has an effect when Chrome is installed.
Entries.Name: BackgroundModeEnabled

Entries.Title: Autologger Cellcore off
Entries.Why: Cellular core trace (SMS router). A session host has no cellular modem. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger ReadyBoot off
Entries.Why: ReadyBoot caches reads for slow disks. On a virtual disk the cache is thrown away with the VM, so it only costs memory and boot time. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger WDIContextLog off
Entries.Why: Diagnostic startup trace for network and Wi-Fi drivers. A VM does not use Wi-Fi. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger WiFiDriverIHVSession off
Entries.Why: Wi-Fi driver diagnostic trace. A VM does not use Wi-Fi. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger WiFiSession off
Entries.Why: Wi-Fi diagnostic trace. A VM does not use Wi-Fi. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger ReFSLog off
Entries.Why: Diagnostic trace of the ReFS file system. Not needed unless a volume uses ReFS. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Autologger Mellanox-Kernel off
Entries.Why: Diagnostic trace of the Mellanox network driver. Not needed without such adapters. The change takes effect after a restart. Only offered when the logger exists on this host.
Entries.Name: Start

Entries.Title: Service: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry (DiagTrack)
Entries.Why: Sends the diagnostic data of Windows. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (sensor reporting), Intune Endpoint Analytics and Windows Update for Business reports depend on that data, so turning it off can break them. Only for hosts that use none of these; off by default.
Entries.Name: DiagTrack

Entries.Title: Service: Downloaded Maps Manager
Entries.Why: Only used by the Maps app, which has no place on a session host.
Entries.Name: MapsBroker

Entries.Title: Service: Geolocation Service
Entries.Why: Provides the location to apps. A session host has no useful location; apps that ask for it get none.
Entries.Name: lfsvc

Entries.Title: Service: Radio Management (airplane mode)
Entries.Why: Manages radios of a device. A virtual machine has none.
Entries.Name: RmSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Payments and NFC/SE Manager
Entries.Why: Manages NFC secure elements. A virtual machine has none.
Entries.Name: SEMgrSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Xbox Live Auth Manager
Entries.Why: Xbox sign-in for games. Not used on a session host.
Entries.Name: XblAuthManager

Entries.Title: Service: Xbox Live Game Save
Entries.Why: Cloud saves of Xbox games. Not used on a session host.
Entries.Name: XblGameSave

Entries.Title: Service: Xbox Accessory Management
Entries.Why: Manages Xbox controllers. Not used on a session host.
Entries.Name: XboxGipSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Xbox Live Networking
Entries.Why: Xbox network features. Not used on a session host.
Entries.Name: XboxNetApiSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Windows Mobile Hotspot
Entries.Why: Shares the connection as a hotspot. Not for a virtual machine.
Entries.Name: icssvc

Entries.Title: Service: Cellular Time
Entries.Why: Sets the time from mobile networks. A virtual machine has none; the time comes from the host.
Entries.Name: autotimesvc

Entries.Title: Service: Microsoft Windows SMS Router
Entries.Why: Routes text messages to apps. Not used on a session host.
Entries.Name: SmsRouter

Entries.Title: Service: Data Usage
Entries.Why: Counts data use and metered networks. Not useful on a session host; other components may read its numbers, so it stays off by default.
Entries.Name: DusmSvc

Entries.Title: Service: SysMain (Superfetch)
Entries.Why: Preloads apps into memory by usage. On a virtual disk and with many sessions it mostly causes disk reads and memory pressure. Keep it on for hosts with slow disks.
Entries.Name: SysMain

Entries.Title: Service: Windows Error Reporting
Entries.Why: Sends crash reports. Disabling it also removes crash dumps that Microsoft support or your own tools may need.
Entries.Name: WerSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Diagnostic Policy Service
Entries.Why: Runs the troubleshooters. Windows troubleshooting for network and performance stops working while it is off.
Entries.Name: DPS

Entries.Title: Service: Diagnostic Execution Service
Entries.Why: Runs diagnostics for the troubleshooters. Same trade-off as the Diagnostic Policy Service.
Entries.Name: DiagSvc

Entries.Title: Service: Diagnostic System Host
Entries.Why: Hosts diagnostics for the Diagnostic Policy Service. Same trade-off.
Entries.Name: WdiSystemHost

Entries.Title: Service: Optimize Drives (defrag)
Entries.Why: Defragmentation does nothing on virtual disks. The retrim of thin-provisioned storage also stops, so only use this with storage that does not need it.
Entries.Name: defragsvc

Entries.Title: Service: Windows Search (indexing)
Entries.Why: WARNING: on multi-session this breaks Outlook search and Start menu search for every user. An older Golden Master script turned it off; this list keeps search on (the per-user index is the multi-session default) and offers the switch only with this warning.
Entries.Name: WSearch

Entries.Title: Task: Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser
Entries.Why: Collects compatibility data that Windows Update for Business reports and the Intune upgrade readiness views use. Costs CPU and I/O on every host that runs it. Off by default: turn it off only when you use none of those reports.

Entries.Title: Task: ProgramDataUpdater
Entries.Why: Collects program telemetry for the compatibility data.

Entries.Title: Task: CEIP Consolidator
Entries.Why: Collects and sends usage data of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.

Entries.Title: Task: CEIP USB
Entries.Why: Sends USB usage data of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.

Entries.Title: Task: CEIP Kernel
Entries.Why: Sends kernel usage data of the Customer Experience Improvement Program.

Entries.Title: Task: Disk Diagnostic data collector
Entries.Why: Reports disk and system data to Microsoft for the CEIP.

Entries.Title: Task: Scheduled Defrag
Entries.Why: Optimizes drives. Does nothing useful on virtual disks; retrim for thin disks stops as well.

Entries.Title: Task: Maps toast
Entries.Why: Shows Maps notifications. The Maps app is not used on a session host.

Entries.Title: Task: Maps update
Entries.Why: Downloads map updates. The Maps app is not used on a session host.

Entries.Title: Task: Family Safety monitor
Entries.Why: Family Safety enforcement. Not used on a company image.

Entries.Title: Task: Family Safety refresh
Entries.Why: Syncs Family Safety settings. Not used on a company image.

Entries.Title: Task: Windows Error Reporting queue
Entries.Why: Sends queued error reports. Disabling it keeps reports on the host.

Entries.Title: Task: Power Efficiency Diagnostics
Entries.Why: Looks for conditions of high energy use. A virtual machine has no such use.

Entries.Title: Task: Memory diagnostic events
Entries.Why: Schedules a memory diagnostic after memory errors. Not meaningful for a VM.

Entries.Title: Task: Full memory diagnostic
Entries.Why: Runs a full memory test. Not meaningful for a VM.

Entries.Title: Task: Recommended troubleshooting scanner
Entries.Why: Checks Microsoft for recommended troubleshooting. Not needed on a managed image.

Entries.Title: Task: Registry idle backup
Entries.Why: Backs up the registry hives. The image is rebuilt from the Golden Master, so the backup is rarely used; keep it on for persistent hosts.

Entries.Title: Task: Speech model download
Entries.Why: Downloads speech models in the background.

Entries.Title: Task: System Restore point
Entries.Why: Creates restore points. Useless on pooled hosts.

Entries.Title: Task: Work Folders logon sync
Entries.Why: Syncs Work Folders at sign-in. Not used with profile containers.

Entries.Title: Task: Work Folders maintenance
Entries.Why: Maintenance of Work Folders. Not used with profile containers.

Entries.Title: Task: Autochk proxy (SQM)
Entries.Why: Collects and uploads autochk data for the CEIP.

Entries.Title: Task: WinSAT performance assessment
Entries.Why: Measures system performance on a schedule. AVDTune has its own benchmark and does not use WinSAT.

Entries.Title: Task: Xbox game save
Entries.Why: Xbox cloud save standby. Not used on a session host.

Entries.Title: Task: Location notification
Entries.Why: Shows the location notification. Location is not used on a session host.

Entries.Title: Task: Cellular provisioning
Entries.Why: Provisioning for cellular devices. A virtual machine has none.

Entries.Title: Defender: block potentially unwanted applications
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: configure detection for potentially unwanted applications to Enabled (block).

Entries.Title: Defender: do not merge local lists with policy lists
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: local administrators cannot override the central exclusion lists. WARNING: Defender exclusions that AVDTune sets locally on this master (for example FSLogix, page FSLogix) are ignored while this is on, unless the same exclusions come from policy. Off by default for that reason. The setting name is not verified on a live host.

Entries.Title: Defender: randomize scheduled scan times
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: spreads the scheduled scans of many VMs that start from one image over time, so they do not all scan at once.

Entries.Title: Defender: cloud protection Advanced MAPS
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: join MAPS with Advanced (cloud-delivered protection).

Entries.Title: Defender: cloud protection level High
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: cloud block level High.

Entries.Title: Defender: extended cloud check 20 seconds
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: extended cloud check timeout of 20 seconds (default plus 20).

Entries.Title: Defender: CPU limit per scan 50 percent
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: limits the CPU a scan may use to 50 percent, so scans do not starve the other sessions.

Entries.Title: Defender: check for security intelligence every 8 hours
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: update interval of 8 hours.

Entries.Title: Defender: catch-up quick scan on
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: runs a quick scan after the VM missed two scheduled scans. An older Golden Master script turned catch-up scans off, which weakens protection. Catch-up scans use more CPU when they run.

Entries.Title: Defender: update security intelligence before a scheduled scan
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: check for the latest intelligence before a scheduled scan.

Entries.Title: Defender: headless UI mode (hide the Defender interface from users)
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: hides the Defender interface from users so sessions do not show the same notifications. Security operations still see detections in the Defender portal.

Entries.Title: Defender: default action for low threats is quarantine
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: threat default actions Quarantine for low, medium, high and severe.

Entries.Title: Defender: default action for medium threats is quarantine
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: threat default actions Quarantine for low, medium, high and severe.

Entries.Title: Defender: default action for high threats is quarantine
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: threat default actions Quarantine for low, medium, high and severe.

Entries.Title: Defender: default action for severe threats is quarantine
Entries.Why: Microsoft VDI guidance: threat default actions Quarantine for low, medium, high and severe.

Entries.Title: New users: classic context menu (Windows 11)
Entries.Why: Every new user gets the full right-click menu at once instead of the short Windows 11 menu with 'Show more options'. Written to the default user profile (an empty (Default) value of InprocServer32 below this CLSID). Not a documented Microsoft setting: the way is described in a Microsoft Q&A article and may stop working with a later Windows build. Undo removes the CLSID key, but only when AVDTune created it. Takes effect at the next sign-in of a new user.

Entries.Title: New users: no web suggestions in the search box
Entries.Why: User policy DisableSearchBoxSuggestions (Windows Explorer ADMX): the search box shows no suggestion pop-ups and no web results, and typed entries are not kept. On a multi-session host that is less traffic and clutter for every user. Written to the default user profile, so every new user gets it; WDOT lists the same value in its default user settings.
Entries.Name: DisableSearchBoxSuggestions

Entries.Title: New users: menus open faster (MenuShowDelay 100 ms)
Entries.Why: MenuShowDelay (REG_SZ, milliseconds) is the wait before a submenu opens; the Windows default is 400. 100 makes menus feel faster in a remote session without opening them on every mouse move. The value 100 is our choice: Microsoft documents the setting and its default, but gives no recommended value for virtual desktops, and WDOT does not set it. Written to the default user profile.
Entries.Name: MenuShowDelay

Entries.Title: New users: no taskbar animations
Entries.Why: Taskbar animations cost frames and bandwidth in a remote session. WDOT turns them off for the default user (TaskbarAnimations 0, its optional visual effects group). Off by default here: some users notice the missing animation; turn it on for hosts where every frame counts.
Entries.Name: TaskbarAnimations
